about: Interface translations for nan (Taiwanese Hokkien / Tâi-gí), written in the Ministry of Education recommended Han characters (臺灣台語推薦用字, traditional), the same standard as the en-nan course (docs/profiles/en-nan.md §2.2). The only course this interface serves is nan-ko (Korean for Taigi speakers), so "Korean", "Hangul" and "romanization" keys are translated literally for Korean (韓語, 韓文字, 羅馬字), and "English" keys literally (英語). Fill every "t" (leave the other fields: they are reference only). Exact keys: the English UI string -> your text. Patterns: the template -> your text with {1}..{k} standing for the slots in template order (reorder freely; every slot must appear). Slot types: n = integer count; f = decimal number; s = short text (lazy match), e.g. a deck or lesson name; x = free text (greedy match); e = e-mail address; d = text without "·", e.g. a deck name inside a "·"-separated line. Follow tools/i18n/nan/NOTES.md (register, glossary, kept loans, open doubts). Then: python3 tools/i18n/gen.py nan && node tools/i18n/validate.js nan
